edge_stage_resolution: Supplier invariant, then consumer dependency_stage_overrides[supplier], then consumer dependency_stage. Overrides must name an existing depends_on edge. Missing required interface/producer/permit remains a real wait.
interface_agreement: Scoped source rebind + native producer and consumer owner agreement on exact version, schema/rule, typed refusals, time/authority meanings, migration and distinguishing oracle. This can precede supplier implementation. It permits isolated construction only; it is neither an emitted artifact nor owner readiness or acceptance.
scoped_rebind: execution/07-scoped-readiness.md: complete affected owner/consumer/companion closure before writes; global original-set reconciliation before FINAL-FREEZE.
deciding_wave_receipt: Complete source/input/backend-qualified deciding output from the named executed wave, with PASS/FAIL/ERROR/SKIP/UNRUN preserved. Receipt existence alone is not a positive or a release decision.

default.owner_readiness: Reviewed native internal output + claim-scoped local positive/adversarial/removal proof, versioned interface and complete companions; a fixture never establishes real external authority. Original authentic/composed criteria not locally provable remain named open.
default.composition: Actual persisted producer outputs and fresh consumers on the final bound source/input/backend; resolve acceptance_dependencies and all selected conditional requirements.
default.original_disposition: Competent owner applies the complete original criterion; no automatic credit from task readiness.

verification_preparation.owner_readiness: Oracle/recipe/input/resource/consumer census and narrowly necessary local preparation are ready. Original full V1–V7 outcome remains UNRUN until FINAL-REPLAY.
verification_preparation.composition: Original complete wave executed after FINAL-REVIEW on final replay identity.
verification_preparation.original_disposition: Exact original Done when and full deciding output govern closure.

FINAL-REPLAY.owner_readiness: Execution coordinator, not a pre-freeze mechanism task. Starting is allowed after final reviewed identity; completion requires all selected wave obligations accounted for by actual outputs.
FINAL-REPLAY.composition: Join LIF-09, GYD-16–22 and every other selected frozen matrix output by exact source/input/backend. Parallel shards have no conflicting active write/resource leases; shared-capacity tickets must fit the actual common budget. PASS requires the original predicates, not merely completed commands.
FINAL-REPLAY.original_disposition: Diagnostics can finish with ERROR/FAIL/UNRUN; accepted programme replay and FINAL-USE remain unavailable while required predicates are unresolved.

GYD-01.owner_readiness: Native N9/admission mechanism and all internal suppliers implemented/reviewed with scoped real-path local proofs. Preserve distinct PR1a/PR1b signals and original authentic near-miss debt.
GYD-01.composition: Actual qualified inputs and true production-lane refused attempted field-pilot request receipt where the original criterion requires it; never run a harmful pilot or label fixtures authentic.
GYD-01.original_disposition: GY-O0-NC-01 and each associated original remain unresolved until their own real evidence/competent ruling. A blocked request, not external execution of policy, is the near-miss criterion.

DEB-09.owner_readiness: All internal intake/resolver/refusal/consumer paths implemented and reviewed. Inventory exact unavailable acts and lawful supplier channels; no appointments fabricated.
DEB-09.composition: Resolve authentic selected acts and their scope/time/competence through independent trust and actual consumer; missing inputs remain typed-empty.
DEB-09.original_disposition: Named authority-slot obligations remain open if required acts absent; a correct refusal is not appointment or closure.

CNT-09.owner_readiness: Selected-facet mapping, actual internal producer/bridge/consumer/surface mechanics and controlled proofs ready. If no sponsor case, retain explicit pending commissioning and genuine-input predicates.
CNT-09.composition: Commissioned case consumes all selected real source artifacts or produces a source-qualified costed refusal; controlled rehearsal cannot be called authentic.
CNT-09.original_disposition: One refusal does not close other original rows or admit public first use.

UI-16.owner_readiness: Honest blocked/not-established performance posture verified at every claimed surface.
UI-16.composition: A positive performance claim additionally requires source-bound substantive promoted-design evidence.
UI-16.original_disposition: Absent evidence remains an unresolved original performance obligation; internal refusal mechanism may be ready.

UI-02.owner_readiness: Publication mechanism, typed-empty/refusal branches, actual issuer/verifier/consumer wiring and isolated verification ready; no external publication implied.
UI-02.composition: Actual data-only/governed case and lawful signer where original criterion requires them. Real publication is behind FINAL-USE and separately authorized action; authenticated test records stay non-public verification.
UI-02.original_disposition: Original publication/custody criteria must be reconciled with their owning scope; scope-only DS8 rows are separately adjudicated at P0, not closed by this build.

OPS-09.owner_readiness: Build selected-tier internal owner mechanism, or bind the original conditional criterion to an explicitly unselected tier, no-parity claim and activation trigger. Unselected is not PASS or closure of a mandatory requirement.
OPS-09.composition: When selected, exact provider/site/mount/trust/runtime evidence is mandatory; otherwise explicit source-qualified non-claim.
OPS-09.original_disposition: Competent owner resolves applicability by the original criterion; no scope reduction by executor preference.

conditional_binding_rule.selection_owner: CNT-01 case facets; OPS-01 deployment profile; root reconciles original obligations at P0 and after selection changes
conditional_binding_rule.activation: Unselected by original conditional scope requires explicit non-claim and reentry trigger, not PASS. Unavailable selected inputs activate a limitation/refusal branch, never disappear. Mandatory original work cannot be made conditional by the executor.
conditional_binding_rule.cycle_rule: Separate stage nodes before cycle analysis. Consumer preparation may use a frozen interface; composition requires actual emitted output. A true cycle is resolved by owner handoff/contract staging or an explicit decision, not removing evidence edges.

replay_identity.final_replay_candidate: After blocking repairs and independent delta review, root freezes the final tree/input/backend/upstream refs in the existing journal. No mutable branch alias as evidence.
replay_identity.after_change: Stop affected acceptance; rebind actual affected source/input/consumer closure and repeat necessary proof. Do not repeat unchanged global work just because a task ID changed.

release: FINAL-USE.required_original_dispositions is mandatory in addition to FINAL-REPLAY. A truthful incomplete replay can finish as a diagnostic run but cannot count as accepted programme closeout. Plan logistics only, no new product gate service.
